provenance.note: Values are the experimentalMax from the SR2 deed Lua scripts (max-roll a well-experimented harvester achieves). Mining harvesters (ore/gas/liquid/moisture/flora) all use the same Core3 baseline ranges: BER 1-5 / 2-6 / 3-7 for personal/medium/heavy, hopper caps 50k/75k/150k. Energy generators (solar/wind/fusion/photo-bio) have a single fixed size in SR2 — no personal/medium/heavy split; we model them all as one heavy entry per type, picking solar as the default 'energy harvester' because it has the highest BER (15) and consumes no fuel. ALL harvesters cost 1 lot on Core3/SR2 (the pre-CU SWG live 1/2/3 cost model was collapsed during the rewrite). Verified 2026-05-11 against ~/workspace/srswgemu2/MMOCoreORB/bin/scripts/object/tangible/deed/harvester_deed/*.lua and generator_deed/*.lua.

harvesters.note: SR2 has no size variants for energy generators. Solar = highest-BER energy harvester (15) with no fuel requirement.
